Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.

Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).

If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;

and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

Iteration 13/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

evidence assessment.

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

prompt:
Iteration 14/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

record.narrative: No assessments are due. The strongest dataset-specific structure is now well characterized: feature_027=1 and feature_037=1 are strong negative tags, feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are strong positive tags, and feature_063=1 appears to be a context-dependent negative signal, supported in core-negative-absent and high feature_038 strata but not in low feature_038 territory. The newly registered claims test whether these associations are separable rather than redundant proxies. The feature_037 and feature_027 high-feature_038 claims require absence of the other major negative tags, testing whether each remains a threshold-level negative contrast when its overlap with feature_063 and the other negative tag is removed. The feature_063 claim asks whether the context-dependent negative signal persists in feature_010-positive territory after excluding feature_027 and feature_037; a threshold result would support a negative signal not explained solely by overlap with established negative tags, while a null or subthreshold result would support redundancy or context dependence. The feature_002 and feature_010 claims test positive-tag separability: feature_002 is evaluated among feature_010-negative, negative-tag-absent participants, and feature_010 is evaluated among feature_002-negative, negative-tag-absent participants. If both remain large positive contrasts, the positive tags behave as partially independent measured associations in this dataset; if one attenuates, that tag may partly reflect the other or an unmeasured shared structure. The analysis priority should be the active feature_063-by-feature_038 interaction H175 and its high-feature_038 core-absent refinement H176, then these five separability refinements, followed by the active low-prevalence binary screens H115-H126. All conclusions remain observational associations in the supplied dataset and do not establish causality, mechanism, clinical meaning, or generalizability. Invalid small-cell diagnostics must be treated as unusable evidence, not evidence of absence.

prompt:
Iteration 14/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation

prompt:
Iteration 14/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: The new results materially strengthen and localize the feature_063 context effect while showing partial separability of the main tag variables. H175 is accepted: the feature_063 effect differs across feature_038 strata, with signed interaction +0.575 and lower bound +0.400. This is far above the 0.15 threshold, and cell sizes are adequate, so it is a strong dataset-specific interaction, likely driven by the previously accepted high-feature_038 association and low-feature_038 null rather than by a marginal feature_063 main effect. H176 accepts the same feature_063 negative signal in high-feature_038 territory when feature_027 and feature_037 are absent, indicating that the high-stratum feature_063 signal is not simply a proxy for either other negative tag. H177 and H178 accept feature_037 and feature_027 as separable negative tags in high-feature_038 territory with the other negative tags and feature_063 removed; both intervals are far above threshold, though H178's exposed cell is only 31, so its estimate is somewhat less precise. H180 and H181 accept positive-tag separability: feature_002 remains a strong positive tag among feature_010-negative, negative-tag-absent participants, and feature_010 remains strong among feature_002-negative, negative-tag-absent participants. These effects are large and have lower bounds far above threshold, so they are robust to multiplicity and likely not just overlapping proxies. H179 remains unresolved and deferred: feature_063 has a point estimate above threshold (+0.171) in feature_010-positive, negative-tag-absent strata, but the signed lower bound is only +0.002; it is too imprecise for acceptance and resembles the previously failed feature_010-positive small-stratum feature_063 result. The low-prevalence binary screens are largely null or subthreshold. H118/H117 (feature_013), H122/H121 (feature_028), H124/H123 (feature_043), and H126/H125 (feature_064) can be rejected in both directions because the signed intervals are entirely below the threshold. H120 rejects the negative feature_022 claim; its opposite positive claim H119 remains deferred because the interval crosses both zero and the threshold despite a below-threshold point estimate. H115/H116 for feature_017 remain deferred because no evidence was obtained. Overall, the evidence supports a dataset-specific structure: feature_027=1 and feature_037=1 are strong negative tags; feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are strong positive tags; and feature_063=1 is a context-dependent negative signal, especially in high-feature_038 territory, with partial separability from the other negative tags. No causal, mechanistic, biological, or generalizable claims are justified.

prompt:
Iteration 14/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative: Reassessed H162 after its validation response. The original claim was that feature_063=1 is associated with a threshold-level negative mean_difference in outcome_001 relative to feature_063=0 within feature_010-positive and feature_002-negative participants. The discovery contrast gave a signed estimate of +0.195 with a 95% lower bound of +0.003 and upper bound of +0.388 (n=39 versus 282), and the independent validation gave a signed estimate of +0.212 with an adjusted lower bound of -0.018 and upper bound of +0.443 (n=37 versus 253). The point estimates are above the 0.15 threshold and consistent in the claimed raw direction, but neither interval clears the threshold, and the validation interval does not even exclude zero. I therefore do not accept a supported dataset-specific association in this small stratum; I mark it unresolved and closed rather than reject, because the evidence is consistent with a weak effect but too imprecise. This refines the feature_063 picture: feature_063 is not a robust marginal negative tag, and its supported negative associations are contextual, especially when feature_027 and feature_037 are absent (validated H155) and especially in high-feature_038 territory (H167, H176, and the strong interaction H175). By contrast, low-feature_038 territory (H168) and positive-tag contexts, including H162, H170, and H179, do not provide threshold-level evidence. The broader supported findings remain: feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are strong positive tags associated with higher outcome_001, feature_027=1 and feature_037=1 are strong negative tags associated with lower outcome_001, and these tags are partially separable in strata that remove overlap with the other major tags. Negative or unsupported findings include the constructed markers feature_007, feature_058, and feature_015; most categorical predictors; most tested interactions; low-prevalence screens feature_013, feature_028, feature_043, and feature_064; and feature_063 in low-feature_038 territory. Remaining unresolved uncertainty includes the marginal overall feature_063 contrast H80, small feature_010-positive feature_063 strata, feature_019 age contrasts, borderline feature_022, and feature_046 level_003-versus-level_001. The most informative next analyses are the active feature_063 context proposals in core-negative-absent participants, especially H184 (feature_063-by-feature_038 interaction among feature_027/feature_037 absent), H185 (low-feature_038 core-negative main contrast), and H186 (high-feature_038 positive-tag-absent main contrast). I also registered a broader feature_063 test in feature_010-positive, feature_027-negative, feature_037-negative participants to address whether the positive-tag context effect can be supported with a larger cell than H162/H179. These are all observational associations in the supplied dataset and do not establish causality, mechanism, biological interpretation, clinical relevance, or generalizability.

prompt:
Iteration 15/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).

If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;

plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Iteration 15/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

prompt:
Iteration 15/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: The new results strongly localize feature_063 and mostly close the proposed secondary screens. H184 and H186 support the feature_038-specific feature_063 effect after removing overlap with feature_027 and feature_037: high-feature_038 negative-direction contrasts are +0.556 [0.381,0.732] for the formal interaction and +0.584 [0.458,0.710] for the positive-tag-absent main contrast, both far above the 0.15 threshold. H185 is rejected because the low-feature_038 core-negative negative-direction contrast is signed -0.024 and contradicts the hypothesized direction without any meaningful magnitude. The feature_018 tests show the feature_063 context is not uniform. The marginal negative feature_063-by-feature_018 interaction H182 is rejected because the signed estimate is -0.429 [-0.611,-0.247], indicating a raw positive attenuation interaction rather than the claimed more-negative high-feature_018 effect. This is consistent with H188 and H189: in high-feature_038, feature_027/feature_037-absent participants, feature_063 is strongly negative among feature_018<=0 (+0.754 [0.578,0.929]) but only suggestive and imprecise among feature_018>=0 (+0.297 [0.083,0.512]). Thus H188 remains unresolved rather than accepted, while H189 is accepted. H190 rejects a negative feature_018-based effect in low-feature_038 core-negative territory. H191 does not support meaningful attenuation or synergy with feature_037; its near-zero point estimate has a wide interval from -0.296 to 0.305 and small exposed cells, so it remains unresolved and deferred. The conditional low-prevalence positive screens H192 and H193 remain unresolved and deferred because their point estimates are below threshold but their upper intervals cross 0.15, leaving them underpowered rather than clearly absent.
